comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Equipment is only indestructible if it has "Effect", which is currently limited to accessories, and a handful of (weak) weapons. I've no complaints with mine; Body Language is difficult to grind, so booster items for it are quite helpful. That skill will soon only cost 5 vigor a use, and if refined at R15, grants a single successful use gives you permanent free communication while in port, IIRC.

To each their own, of course.
